name: Sian
source:
Sian is a manakravter in [url=/c45469]Melano's[/url] party, who participated in the assault on Rughzenhaide.

She is a collected, intelligent individual who suffers from a penchant for lamenting physical labor. For this reason, she was tasked with the duty of gathering intelligence for Melano's party.

[Edited from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/fault-milestone-one-directors-cut/description?lang=es]Fault's Kickstarter[/url]]
